evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/realtor/[id]/page.tsx — the public agent/realtor profile page (route /[locale]/realtor/[id], screen-map docs/screens/reality/agent-profile.md) imports NO useTranslations/getTranslations (grep count 0) across ~621 non-comment lines, yet reality-web is an explicitly 4-locale public portal (sk/cs/de/en per CLAUDE.md).

Every user-facing label is a hardcoded Slovak literal: line 161 'Aktívne inzeráty', 162 'Predaných (12m)', 163 'Priem. dni na trhu', 165 'Hodnotenie', 291 'Predaj'/'Prenájom' (sale/rent badge). So a cs/de/en visitor to an indexed agent profile sees the entire page in Slovak. The page carries data-i18n="pages.agent-profile.root" marker attributes but they are never wired to a translation namespace.
line 311 also hardcodes the number/date formatting locale to 'sk-SK' (toLocaleString('sk-SK')), so price/stat formatting is Slovak-grouped for all four locales regardless of visitor.

Landable frontend-only fix: introduce a realtor/agent-profile translation namespace (next-intl messages for sk/cs/de/en), replace the hardcoded literals with t('...') via useTranslations, and derive the Intl locale from the route [locale] param instead of the 'sk-SK' literal. Matches the previously-shipped ComparisonView i18n finding (code-review-reality-web-comparison-view-i18n).

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/agency/[slug]/page.tsx — the public agency profile page (~325 lines) has zero useTranslations/getTranslations (grep count 0) on the same 4-locale public portal.

User-facing strings are hardcoded Slovak, including the two state screens that a non-sk visitor is most likely to hit: line 36 loading state '>Načítavam…<', line 46 not-found state '>Kancelária sa nenašla.<', line 223 empty-listings state '>Žiadne aktívne ponuky.<', and line 302 CTA '🌐 Navštíviť web'. The not-found and empty states render Slovak for cs/de/en visitors of an SEO-indexed page.
Landable frontend-only fix: add an agency-profile next-intl namespace (sk/cs/de/en) and replace the loading / not-found / empty-state / CTA literals with t('...') resolved from the route [locale].

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/account/listings/[id]/edit/page.tsx — the authenticated listing-edit form (~930 lines) has zero useTranslations/getTranslations (grep count 0) with ~18 hardcoded Slovak strings, so the whole edit flow renders Slovak for cs/de/en account holders on a 4-locale portal.

Spans error/status messaging and form labels: line 166 'Načítanie inzerátu zlyhalo.', 213 'Uloženie zlyhalo, skúste znova.', 223 'Načítavam inzerát…', 384/725 'Prenájom', 429 'Ulica a číslo', 466 'Počet izieb', 468 'Celkový počet poschodí', 469 'Rok výstavby', 665/746 'Aktívny', 666/748 'Neaktívny', 827 'Ukladám…'/'Uložiť zmeny'.

Lower severity than the public realtor/agency pages (authenticated, not SEO-indexed) but the same systemic gap. Landable frontend-only fix: add a listing-edit next-intl namespace and replace the literals with t('...') resolved from the route [locale].
